### Turn off reels and shorts for yourself
Two new cards on the home screen. **Reels & Shorts** sends YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and Facebook Reels links back to the site's home page in your browser, so the endless feed is not one tap away. **Telegram & WhatsApp** closes Telegram's global search and sends you back to Chats when you open WhatsApp's Updates — in the apps and on the web.
These already existed for Macs looked after by a family or an organisation. Now anyone can switch them on for themselves.
Turning a guard on is immediate. Turning one off asks for your PIN, if you have set one — the point of these is the moment you would rather not be asked twice.
Each card shows what is running at a glance, and a lock where the choice belongs to whoever manages the Mac rather than to you.
### Website filtering for managed Macs that block only risky words
On a Mac whose organisation had turned on risky-word blocking without also blocking any sites, the browser check never started — the protection read as on and did nothing. It now runs.
